column3: Mercury is lit.\nI failed to guard it.\nWhy should I trust you?{end_wait}
Menardi has Jenna\nand Kraden. We're here\nto bring them home.{end_wait}
I swore to protect\nthis lighthouse.\nI was too late.{end_wait}
Then help us now.\nMenardi is escaping.\nWe can still reach her.{end_wait}

I don't know if
I can trust you.
But they need help.{page_break}I'll follow Menardi.
You keep Saturos here.{end_wait}
Go, healer.\nThe beacon is already lit.{end_wait}
I stopped you\nwhile Menardi escaped.\nThat was my mistake.{end_wait}
She's heading\nfor the far ledge.\nI can still catch her.{end_wait}
I know. I'll bring\nher back if I can.\nPlease trust me.{end_wait}
If I can't free them,\nI won't leave them\nalone with her.{end_wait}
Your healer is gone.\nNow face me.{end_wait}
